page.overview:
Who is Badmil?

Badmil was a male Twi'lek merchant who lived on Tython during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A Twi'lek male, Badmil was one of many Pilgrims who settled illegally on the planet Tython in the Deep Core. He ran a business in Kalikori village, where he sold a variety of weapons.
